quarterly_data.quarter: Luxshare investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (10-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: for optical-module materials, some core materials are supplied under the customer's lead, and for other materials it has a safeguard mechanism of diversified sourcing, backup plans and forward stocking; with customer support, earlier stocking plans and supply-chain coordination, the related material supply currently matches its orders and production needs well. On overseas export controls, it said it has so far found no material adverse impact on its overall operations, and its main business and orders are proceeding in order according to customer demand.
